messages:
sara.p: FYI onboarding call with FinData SI just finished. They hit three blockers during the private deploy validation: missing egress allowlist for the marketplace image pull, terraform provider mismatch for our private module, and unclear KMS/HSM key policy expectations. Need quick triage so go-live doesn't slip.

devon.s: Ugh. Can you paste the exact failure logs from their run? Also which image tag did they pull?

sara.p: They used `redwood/private-image:v2.1.0` — error was `403 forbidden` when pulling from marketplace bucket. From their infra engineer: "download failed: access denied when fetching layers". I can DM the stack trace but here's the gist.

maria.cs: Is this the partner using our marketplace provisioning flow (i.e., cloud-marketplace + private DB stage) or a straight on-prem image load? That changes the auth path.

sara.p: It's cloud-marketplace -> private VPC (customer requested marketplace image + onprem runtime). So still uses our marketplace signed URL flow.

alex.k: For the terraform provider mismatch — which provider version are they on? We bumped the private module to require `redwood_tf >= 1.3.0` last month. If they're on 1.2.x that could blow up the plan/apply step.

sara.p: They posted this excerpt: `Error: provider "registry.terraform.io/redwood/redwood" v1.2.4 does not support resource "redwood_private_deploy"`

devon.s: Okay that's straightforward. Action: ask them to pin provider to `>=1.3.0` or we can backport a compatibility shim. Which do we prefer given schedule?

maria.cs: Can we avoid backport? We should prefer partner upgrades to reduce patch churn. But if they can't upgrade this week, let's fast-track a compatibility patch and cut a 1.2.5 that accepts both resource schemas.

alex.k: I'll start the compatibility diff. If we do a patch, we should also update the Terraform docs and add a compatibility test in our CI.

deploy-bot: Deployment policy check: partner-release-window 2h window required for marketplace image push. Next available: 2025-05-14 22:00 UTC.

sara.p: Noted — FinData asked for earlier go-live (next week). We might need to request an exception or provide them a temporary signed image URL from S3.

devon.s: For the 403 image pull, likely missing an allowlist entry on their side or our signed URL policy expired. Two parallel asks: (1) @sara.p can you confirm the marketplace push completed and the signed URL generation logs? (2) @alex.k please check if our signed URL TTL matches partner expectations — some SIs have longer artifact retention.

sara.p: Confirmed push completed at 2025-05-08T16:42:11Z (push logs attached in DM). Signed URL TTL default = 1h. Partner reported download attempt ~3h after push.

alex.k: TTL mismatch then. We can either extend TTL for marketplace-private flow or provide a one-off longer URL for FinData. I'll coordinate with infra.

maria.cs: KMS/HSM gotchas — what specifically did their SecOps flag?

sara.p: Two items: (1) they require a key rotation policy documented (customer compliance) and (2) HSM-backed keys need path for key import / escrow. They also want to confirm our KMS integration won't send plaintext keys to the partner.

devon.s: That's a compliance ask — needs input from security/compliance folks. @maria.cs can you loop in security? I'll draft a short note explaining our HSM model: customer-managed key stored in their KMS; Redwood stores only key reference and never transmits plaintext.

maria.cs: I'll ping @security and @legal for the key rotation doc and import guidance. Also recommend we create a short runbook fragment to include with all SI handoffs: "KMS expectations + Terraform provider pin + image pull checklist".

sara.p: Great. From FinData side they also want a post-arch-review checklist so their ops team can self-validate. Any chance we can share a minimal checklist today?

alex.k: I can draft a 1-page checklist: required ports, marketplace image steps, provider pin, signed URL TTL note, KMS pointers. Ports snippet: ```
# Required outbound from customer VPC to Redwood
- TCP 443 (artifact pulls)
- TCP 5222 (optional agent heartbeat)
- TCP 10250 (k8s kubelet, if using onprem kube)
```

devon.s: Add this snippet to checklist: terraform version `1.5.x` recommended, provider `redwood/redwood >= 1.3.0`. Also add a quick `terraform init -upgrade` note.

maria.cs: Next steps / owners: (1) @alex.k draft checklist + compatibility patch PR if needed (owner: alex) (2) @maria.cs loop security/legal for KMS doc + produce runbook fragment (owner: maria) (3) @sara.p request one-off longer signed URL and schedule arch review call with FinData (owner: sara) (4) @devon.s be on standby for infra troubleshooting during their validation window.

sara.p: I'll schedule a 30m architecture review tomorrow with FinData (they said 09:30 PST). Sending invites now. I'll request the longer signed URL and confirm provider version on their side.

alex.k: Starting the PR branch now. If we need to cut a hotfix, ping me and I'll prioritize a release.

deploy-bot: Release pipeline note: hotfix branch must pass smoke tests and compatibility suite before a marketplace patch can be published. Estimated pipeline time ~45m.

sara.p: Thanks all — will update thread after the call. :thumbsup:

maria.cs: Thanks, team. This is exactly the sort of handoff that should live in the partnerships runbook — adding to backlog.

devon.s: LGTM. I'll be online during the 09:30 PST window.
